messages:
maria: Proposal: add a "routing insights" panel in Console showing per-request routing decision: tier, region, selected model variant, and fallback reason. Also surface the small routing header blob. Thinking sample-first (1%) + link to full request trace. Thoughts?

devon: Love it. Two quick concerns: (1) schema for the header + decision snapshot, (2) telemetry volume and PII.

ajay: Agree on sampling. Also suggest we show aggregated counts/ratios (fallback rate, per-variant traffic) instead of an unbounded stream.

lucy: UX idea: small inline "Why this route?" flyout on request detail that shows each rule evaluated and the outcome (canary rules, tier check, region, capacity fallback).

sam: perf note: storing full KV cache + headers for every request is heavy. I suggest emitting a compact decision event (enum'd fields) + trace_id for full fetch. Cold store the full trace for on-demand retrieval.

maria: Example header we could emit (proto):
```
x-rw-routing: tier=enterprise;region=eu-west;policy=latency-first;variant=redwood-8b-q4;fallback_reason=quant-fallback
trace_id=01a4f3c9...
```
We should standardize keys and use short enumerated values (no free-text reasons).

irina: Privacy: absolutely redact any raw customer or user ids. Use hashed_customer_id + key rotation salt. Also instead of raw token counts include a cost_estimate bucket (low/med/high).

ajay: For sampling, propose dynamic sampling that increases for new rollouts or elevated error/fallback rates (e.g., from 1% -> 25% when fallback_rate > 0.5%).

devon: Ops API idea: GET /internal/routing/trace/{trace_id} returns full decision log + input headers (redacted). Need to decide auth scope (platform+obs teams).

maria: Console features I want: per-route histogram, fallback frequency trend, per-variant p95 latency, and a small table of recent sampled decision events with quick link to the trace. Wireframe help pls.

lucy: I'll sketch a mock for the panel: top-level KPIs, time-series for fallback_rate, and a "decision inspector" pane. Add filters: tier, region, rollout-tag, model-variant.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for redwood-8b-q4 -> 5% traffic in eu-west.

sam: Can we expose this in Console soon? Backend needs: sampled event pipeline + index + internal API. Rough ETA: platform infra 3w, UI 1w for initial mock.

maria: Action items: @devon prototype header schema + internal API (due Fri), @irina privacy checklist + hashing details, @lucy mock for "routing insights". I'll open a GH issue and link this thread.

devon: Ack. I'll post a small PR with proto schema and example payloads (incl sampling metadata).

ajay: Add metric: percentage of requests with any fallback (boolean) per-tier and per-region. That'll help SLOs and runbooks.

maria: Perfect. Thanks team :thumbsup:
